lines.text: Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys, cedar logs, stonemasons, and carpenters to build David a palace, and David knew the LORD had established him.
When the Philistines heard David was anointed king over all Israel, they searched for him and raided the Valley of Rephaim.
David inquired of God, defeated the Philistines at Baal-perazim, and ordered their abandoned gods burned in the fire.
When the Philistines raided again, God told David to circle around and attack them in front of the mulberry trees.
David did as God commanded, and they struck down the Philistine army from Gibeon to Gezer.
